title: DIAG-09 probe reproduction registration (plan 65-04)
committed_before: the first original rerun; the reading rule is immutable after observation (D-02)

pinned.note: admission revalidates all 33 PINNED_MODULES digests through load_protocol()

runtime_reconstruction.note: CPU float64 seed-42 initialization is the original probe's reconstruction; it is NOT the historical MPS float32 training initialization (D-04). Recorded states load only after their committed record and weight SHA-256 agree, with weights_only=True and a CPU map location.

reading_rule.statement: every registered available historical numeric field reproduces (exact formatter equality against its preserved token) or is marked not_reproduced; all required fields reproduced keeps the exploratory association on record (retained); any failed required comparison withdraws the lead and yields a SCOPE-49 proposal for the owner; a field the shared measurement cannot produce and a figure whose original source is absent are reported separately, never a fabricated failure or success (D-07)
reading_rule.comparison: exact formatter equality: .2f all-arm and single-arm frequency, .3f all-arm cosines and range, .4f all-arm output movement and all single-arm cosines/output, .3g rate ratios; no tolerance is widened by counting visible digits
reading_rule.cells: each token's exact rounding cell (first/last representable doubles, hex, inclusion, excluded nextafter neighbours) is recorded beside it and cross-checked against the formatter before any comparison
reading_rule.new_measurements: individual deep-layer values the original output never printed (all arms except r1-1632) are recorded with status new_measurement, raw value and deltas to the registered range, never an invented historical target (D-03)
reading_rule.interpretation: low mean neighbour cosine is a measured association only; it does not establish information loss, a capacity limit or a cause (D-07)

formatters.note: the .3g formatter omits trailing zeros (1.9e+08 is three-significant-digit rounding); counting visible digits would widen acceptance

supplement.note: the single-arm script's Adam and polish output, registered separately from the all-arm table; its h3 values (adam 0.0186, polish 0.0177) are individual .4f fields, never merged into the all-arm range token 0.018

logger_parity.note: diagnostic_fit.log_similarity on the registered r1-1632 polish state, without updates

limitations: the single-arm moving, spike and skip/siren columns are preserved verbatim with their own formatters but are not measurable by the one shared measurement implementation (a second reduction is forbidden by D-05); the reading rule reports them separately and never fabricates a result for them
missing original source output is a provenance limitation, separately reported, never a failed reproduction (D-03)
